tools.name: create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Builds an invoice draft from details the user stated and returns a private link where they review it and send it themselves (e.g. on WhatsApp). Never sends anything. Only use prices, taxes and client details the user gave. Links, bank/tax-authority/payment-brand names are not allowed.

tools.name: get_supported_options
tools.description: Lists the currencies and invoice languages ReciboPro supports.
